title: Southshore Town Hall
wikitext:
[[Image:Southshore Town Hall.jpg|thumb|300px|Southshore Town Hall.]]
The [[Southshore Town Hall]] is an important structure to the remants of [[Lordaeron]], as it, along with the one at [[Hillsbrad]] is the only one to still belong to the [[human]]s, as all the others have fallen to the [[Syndicate]] or the [[undead]]. [[Magistrate Henry Maleb]] is the town's ruler, and holds his office in this building.
